brief: The canvas displays a vast, deep space cosmic landscape featuring a blend of stars and nebulae. The background is characterized by deep indigo undertones, creating the void between brilliant celestial objects. Visible within this darkness are wispy, glowing filaments of deep cyan and vibrant magenta, representing nebulae. The entire scene exhibits a slow, constant drift and twinkling, giving the impression of infinite depth and stellar motion. The arrangement of colors and the subtle motion are purely visual, requiring no interaction to observe.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive cosmic landscape using only 2D p5.js rendering. It simulates deep space by layering animated stars and nebula filaments against a deep indigo background. The technique uses multiple layers of particles with varying sizes, opacities, and speeds to create depth and motion, while subtle color shifts in the nebula elements produce a glowing, ethereal effect. The scene continuously evolves without user interaction, giving the impression of infinite cosmic drift and twinkling stellar motion.
